1.title: Do you already have land?
1.hint: If you don't, you can buy one of ours or get a quote for the house only.

2.title: Where will you build?
2.hint: The cost changes a little by department, because of freight and labor.

3.title: Choose your home design
3.hint: Prices are with standard finishes. You choose the finish in the next step.

4.title: Which finishes do you want?
4.hint: The finish changes the materials you see: floors, kitchen, bathrooms and windows.

5.title: Any extras?
5.hint: This is optional. You can also add them later.

7.title: Where should we send your quote?
